tiktok_scenario.label: KNOWN
tiktok_scenario.reason: TikTok is operational in Nepal, but Nepal Public Health Service Act 2018 section 45 prohibits production, distribution, dissemination and transmission of advertising material affecting health including alcohol. Therefore no public alcohol promotion or paid campaign should launch without written local legal and platform approval.

core_conclusions.culture_principle: Lead with verified Nepali hosting, sharing, food and adult occasion facts; use Chinese origin and Fenjiu craft as supporting explanation, not political or civilizational superiority.
largest_risks: public alcohol-promotion prohibition and changing platform enforcement
unknown SKU/price/margin/inventory causing an incomplete channel offer
first-trial sensory barrier and weak retailer recommendation causing no replenishment
core_conclusions.day90_validation: Verify a repeatable licensed-venue use case and replenishment, not awareness alone: 8-15 trial outlets, at least 30% of trial outlets replenishing, one repeatable adult occasion, and no compliance incident.

sources.conclusion: Alcohol advertising is limited to approved markets and requires local legality, licensing, age controls, ABV and responsibility messaging; under-25 talent and excessive drinking are prohibited.

sources.title: TikTok alcohol market-specific requirements

sources.title: Nepal Tourism Board - Tihar
